title: B-F1: Paper B's single final KTVIC test look of the stacked system, P1 + the S1 seed-consensus MBR-3
status: frozen before any B-F1 output exists; REGISTERED only if this file is committed before any B-F1 decode output (D-W13-6; CHECKLIST C3: commit time < output mtime)

decision.quote: DECISION: Option (A). Register B-F1 now as P1 + S1 MBR-3 and run its one KTVIC test look on M1 this week. (C) is optional under conditions C1-C4 below. (B) is rejected. S6 and S8 never enter the KTVIC stack. CONFIDENCE: 88%.

Q4.quote: Q4 Paper B owns the stacked system (88%). Under the PD-6 claim ledger, the KTVIC system belongs to B, so B becomes method + audit. Its venue choice is revisited if the system wins. - Paper A may cite it only as a motivating example of evidence-adding, never as a primary result. - The single test evaluation is pre-registered once. Components already tested on test (UPE, PLAN-F1, the seed-MBR proxy) are disclosed in a test-look ledger.

Q5.quote: Q5 YES, acceptable as exploratory (85%): - label the +3.05 [+1.03, +5.11] proxy as a test look, in the paper and in the test-look ledger; - never use it to choose the S1 variant; selection is on dev with dev-trained seeds; - the confirmatory S1 test number comes only from the pre-registered final evaluation.

b1.quote: 1. Members. - Use exactly the S1 members p1dev_s42, p1dev_s43 and p1dev_s44, with the adapter sha256 values from the S1 record. They are decoded fresh on KTVIC test (558 images), with S1's greedy short-prompt settings. - NOT the p1assist seeds. Their test captions have already been seen: the +3.05 proxy is MBR over exactly those captions, and UPE and B-N2 also used them. MBR over them would only recompute a look already made. - Judge check: no p1dev test decode exists anywhere (106 p1dev files, all dev300). - Optional: p1assist MBR under the registered utility, as a descriptive row labelled "previously seen captions", with no verdict.

b2.quote: 2. Variant and code. - The carried variant stays unchanged: the per-image medoid by rl_reward.CiderD, with document frequencies from the 3,469 train-minus-dev300 references. No test reference enters the selection. - Use the committed S1 code path (seed_consensus.py). No new MBR implementation. No change of utility, document frequencies, prompt or decode settings. Short prompt only. - Self-check before any test statistic: reproduce the S1 gate (D_MBR 2.5498 [0.0035, 5.2374], dCHAIR_i -0.193) from the S1 dev outputs. If the self-check fails, stop.

b3.quote: 3. Primary endpoint and rule, fixed before the look. - D_MBR = mean over the 558 images of [CIDEr_i(MBR) - member mean], word-level CIDEr-D x100. - Scoring: the evaluate.py protocol card; per-image values are asserted equal to the corpus value within 1e-6; F0 is required. - CI: paired percentile bootstrap over test images, B = 5000 (R14-4), default_rng(0), sorted-id order. - Verdict: sign_gt_0, as worded in B-N1 section 6. - The frozen R14-4 and S1 prediction table (dCIDEr +1.0 to +3.0, and the rest) is reported as a check of whether the point lies inside its interval. It is not the verdict.

b4.quote: 4. Secondary endpoints, word for word from R14-4 section 3 A and S1: - K2: CHAIR_i more than 1.0 pp above the member mean is reported as harm. - K3: a test F1 drop whose CI excludes 0 is reported as a negative. - Object claims need the PD-2 count-matched primary plus a registered panel side. Without both, object metrics are descriptive and enter no abstract sentence. - BLEU-4 and mentions per caption are descriptive, against the predictions.

b5.quote: 5. Test set. - The full 558 images are primary. - The clean 157 is a descriptive sensitivity only, with no verdict (B-N2 MDE about +/-14). - State that the PD-19 leakage finding does not apply, because training is KTVIC-only.

b6.quote: 6. Test-look ledger, complete inside the prereg: - Every earlier KTVIC-test computation on P1-family outputs: the P1/p1assist test scores, UPE, PLAN-F1, the +3.05 proxy (p1assist, syllable level, test-reference document frequencies) and B-N2's subset statistics. - State that none of them used a p1dev member, and none informed the choice of variant (dev gate only). - Record the Stage-2 status: - S6 and S8 were eligible but not run, decided in PD-22 before any B-F1 output (reasons: cost, and R14-4's expected KTVIC effect of +/-1); - S4 is not eligible (S3 FAIL); - S7 is closed (D14); - XV-EF1 was not carried.

b7.quote: 7. Procedure (CC-018 precedent). - Commit the prereg; commit the instrument addendum (scorer and job sha); pass the scorer through the gate with a synthetic dry run, all before any test decode. - Decode once on M1. Nobody reads the test captions before scoring. - Score once from the committed copy. An independent verifier re-runs it (CC-038b canonical form). Commit through the gatekeeper. - No re-decode or re-score after any output has been read. A failure stops the work and comes back to the judge.

b8.quote: 8. Closure. After B-F1, Paper B makes no further KTVIC-test look for any method. Any later KTVIC-side item is dev300-only and exploratory.

kill_rules.K-SC: the self-check fails: stop before any test statistic
kill_rules.K-PROV: a decode fails admission (sha256 sidecar, SHA256SUMS, provenance: machine, job, evaluate.py, adapter, base revision, test data, commit carrying this registration, decoded after its commit): stop
kill_rules.K-COV: a member lacks a prediction for a test id: stop
kill_rules.K-F0: F0 fails for any system: stop; D_MBR is not computed
kill_rules.after_stop: the record states which rule fired; the work comes back to the judge

disclosures: The +3.05 [+1.03, +5.11] proxy (L4) was seen before this registration; it is a test look (PD-9 Q5) and played no part in choosing the variant, which the S1 dev300 gate chose.

PD-22 risks, quoted: - The one look is spent on a single-component stack. A stronger later lever cannot be confirmed on KTVIC. - The p1dev members are trained on 300 fewer images, so the absolute test CIDEr will sit a little below full-train P1. The claim is the paired delta; report the absolute number descriptively and with that note. - The dev lower bound is 0.0035, so the test verdict may be INCONCLUSIVE. Report it as it comes.
Decode-only: evaluate.py receives the images list of test_data.json without captions, so no test score exists before score_b_f1.py run; generation arguments are S1's.
The MBR selection reads no test reference; its document frequencies come from the train-minus-dev300 references.
No model-generated signal is used as gold; the scored references are KTVIC's human captions.

S1's dev decodes ran on an RTX 3090; the B-F1 decode runs on a new rental under decode.machine.rule (CC-042). All three members are decoded on one host, so the paired delta is within one host; a card difference touches only the absolute numbers.
deviations: Any change after this freeze goes into a new dated file, committed through the gatekeeper before the affected output exists, and is reported next to every number it touches.
